verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents running user access reviews directly in-app. It pulls user data from native/custom integrations or CSV, designates reviewers per system on recurring schedules with reminders, and lets reviewers decide to maintain, modify, revoke, or mark out of scope and then close the review, with follow-up tasks synced to ticketing tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the completed review artifact is stored in an evidence library or mapped to controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
